scope: Pinned OSS CAD suite ARM native IHP flip-flop plus synthetic X/Z and delayed events, 50 million cycles, strict runtime/mapped-file identity, separate-runner restore trace byte-identical. Not full-chip MBIST completion.
next_scope: Same original full-chip netlist, firmware, all native models and exact flags. Compare uninterrupted first 20000 cycles against checkpoint after 10000 and separate-runner continuation. Original sources hash checked. No RTL modification, MBIST bypass or RAM preload. Prefix proof only; full MBIST/28-check boot still required.
